task_title: Tripping 5-inch Drill Pipe & Racking Stands on Monkey Board

steps.task_description: Ascend mast ladder to monkey board (85 ft elevation).
potential_hazards: Catastrophic fall from heights exceeding 80 feet
Slippery rungs due to synthetic oil-based mud mist

steps.task_description: Latch elevator on drill pipe stand and guide pipe into fingerboard.
potential_hazards: Severe hand pinch points between elevator latch and drill pipe tool joint
Swinging pipe impact against worker torso

steps.task_description: Break out drill pipe connection with hydraulic iron roughneck.
potential_hazards: Pinch points on torque wrench dies
required_controls: Verify all personnel clear of roughneck swing radius before activation
